summary: Verify on a real Mac that a trackpad pinch zooms the IMAGE, not the whole interface. Ctrl+wheel UI zoom was removed because macOS delivers a pinch as a wheel event with ctrlKey true, so the document-level handler in js/init.js hijacked every pinch into a webFrame zoom. Fix is written and the node suite passes; it is unverifiable on Windows without a precision touchpad and the rented Mac is gone. Blocked on hardware only.
